role: Spellblade - Fire's burst with Wind's speed [B]
rule: Lightning marks a target and overloads it: every lightning hit leaves Live marks, and the third mark is an Overload - a burst that stuns the target and arcs to every other marked enemy within 12 m - that leaves you Quickened for 1.5 s.

new_mechanics.name: quicken_on_overload
new_mechanics.definition: Affinity rule key: each Overload the caster causes leaves them Quickened (the existing player state) for this many seconds (1.5); a new Overload refreshes it.

skills.name: Arc Lash
skills.summary: Instant and short: it cannot miss what it points at. 85 damage and a Live mark, then it arcs to one more enemy within 4 m for the same. Walls stop it.
skills.verb_fit: Arc is "jump between targets": the hit leaps on, as Fire's burn catches from body to body, but in an instant (Wind's speed).

good_modifiers.word: Charged Lash: two marks a hit
Shorting Lash: harder on the marked
Tight Lash: a harder, shorter line

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: isolate the target it is meant to jump from. The jump is cancelled
a beam that cannot miss has nothing to pierce for; falls back
an instant beam has nothing that lasts; falls back

skills.change_note: No change in play; its recovery (the default 0.12 s) is written out for the speed aspect.

skills.name: Thunderclap Palm
skills.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Live marks, and it stops whatever it was doing. The crack Dazes and staggers everyone within 2.5 m of it, the target too.
skills.verb_fit: Thunder is "a deafening crack that staggers": the blade-hand strike is Fire's Kiln Fist (a heavy blow that bursts on the neighbours), with Wind's Drop in the crack of air.

good_modifiers.word: Charged Palm: three marks, an Overload in one blow
Wide Palm: the crack reaches farther
Shorting Palm: harder on the marked

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: silence a thunderclap. It should not act
a palm strike already lands; pierce does nothing
a blow has nothing that lasts but the daze; falls back

skills.change_note: No change in play; its recovery (the default 0.12 s) is written out for the speed aspect.

skills.name: Stepped Leader
skills.summary: You are simply there, up to 6 m away: over enemies and gaps, not through walls or stone. Everything beside where you land takes 30 and a Live mark, and you are Quickened for 2 s after.
skills.verb_fit: Quicken is "nerves in overdrive": Wind's Tailwind made instant, and you arrive with the blade already moving.

good_modifiers.word: Far Leader: you land farther away
Charged Leader: two marks on landing

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite in spirit: held in place, you cannot blink. Falls back
nothing to pierce; falls back
a blink has nothing that lasts but the Quickened; falls back

skills.change_note: The landing now strikes (30) as well as marking: the spellblade arrives cutting.

skills.name: Static Coat
skills.summary: 6 s: every bare strike you land adds a Live mark and sparks on to the nearest other enemy within 3 m, marking it too; an enemy that hits you in melee takes 25 and a mark.
skills.verb_fit: Charge is "build up marks": Fire's Stoke coats your hands in flame; this coats your blade in charge, so every strike builds toward the Overload.

good_modifiers.word: Leaping Coat: the spark jumps once more
Raging Coat: the retaliation hits harder

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: spend the marks the coat is for building. It should not act
your blade has no range; falls back to a cost cut
a coat on you, somewhere else; falls back

skills.change_note: Every bare strike marks (was every second one), and sparks on to a second enemy within 3 m: the spellblade's imbue, on the coat key Fire's Stoke and Poison use (strikes_per_mark is gone).

skills.name: Stored Bolt
skills.summary: Hold up to 1.2 s, walking slowly; let go and you are the bolt: you cross 4 m at a tap, 8 m at a full hold, through everything in the way. Each body you pass takes 80 to 220 and 1 to 3 Live marks by how long you held. A full charge Overloads the whole line.
skills.verb_fit: Charge is "build up marks": Fire's burst (hold it, then spend it all) carried by Wind's speed (Crosscut's cut through the line).

new_mechanics.name: release streak
new_mechanics.definition: A charge_release may release as a streak (the built Glint kind): you cross range (range_min at a tap, range at a full hold) in an instant, through bodies, applying on_pass to each one within pass_radius.

good_modifiers.word: Earthed Bolt: it leaves less reflux
Narrow Bolt: a tighter, harder line

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite in use: isolating one target on a line through many. It should not act
the line already hits everything it crosses; a jump off it is wasted
a bolt you ride, held in place; falls back

skills.change_note: Released as a streak that carries you (it was a beam from where you stood): the spellblade's charged lunge.

skills.name: Dead Short
skills.summary: Every marked enemy within 12 m Overloads now: 40% of the full blow and stun at 1 mark, 70% at 2, all of it at 3. It grounds no reflux.
skills.verb_fit: Discharge is "release them as an overload": Fire's Pyre Call (every burn blown out at once), with marks for burns.

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: build marks while spending them. It should not act
isolates the bodies it means to set off; it should not act
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.change_note: No change in play; recovery written out for the speed aspect.

skills.name: Forked Path
skills.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then up to three more within 5 m of each other: you flash from one to the next, striking each from behind for 1.2x strike damage and a Live mark, and stop behind the last. Never the same body twice.
skills.verb_fit: Arc is "jump between targets": the arc carries you with it - Wind's Crosscut (through and behind) made a chain, Fire's spreading made a path.

new_mechanics.name: carries_caster
new_mechanics.definition: A chain that takes the caster with it: you appear behind each target as it is struck (a hit from behind), and stay behind the last one. A wall or stone between two targets ends the chain there.

good_modifiers.word: Shorting Path: harder on the marked

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: block the jump it is made of. The path ends at once
a path that holds you in place cannot carry you; falls back
a run of strikes has nothing that lasts; falls back

skills.change_note: It now carries you and strikes with your weapon (1.2x strike damage, from behind) instead of a flat 50 sent from where you stand. Cost 12 -> 14.

skills.name: Seize Up
skills.summary: Everything within 3 m locks up: 30 damage, and Stunned for 0.4 s for every Live mark it carries (0.2 s if none). It spends no marks.
skills.verb_fit: Stun is "nerves locked": Fire's Backdraft cashes in the heat that is there; this cashes in the marks that are there, as stun, at blade's reach.

good_modifiers.word: Charged Seize: a mark first, so it stuns longer

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: nerves in overdrive on a skill that locks them. It should not act
a ring round you has nothing to pierce; falls back
a lock has its own time; falls back

skills.name: Plumb Bolt
skills.summary: One enemy within 14 m is struck from straight above: 100 damage, 30 poise and a Live mark. Bodies, shields and low walls between you do not stop it.
skills.verb_fit: Strike is "a bolt that hits one target": Fire's one big single blow (Sear), from the sky. The spellblade's reach to a runner.

good_modifiers.word: Cracking Plumb: Dazes and more poise
Shorting Plumb: harder on the marked

bad_modifiers.why: a bolt from straight above has nothing to jump from on the way; the jump is wasted
it already ignores what is between; falls back
an instant bolt; falls back

skills.change_note: No change in play; recovery written out for the speed aspect.

skills.name: Ground Rod
skills.summary: Point, 8 m: a rod for 10 s that blocks nothing. Each lightning skill you cast within 8 m of it also arcs from the rod to the nearest enemy within 5 m: 40 and a mark. One rod at a time.
skills.verb_fit: Ground is "earth a charge away; draw strikes to a point": a point that keeps striking for you, as Fire's Slag Pool keeps burning where you left it.

good_modifiers.word: Charged Rod: two marks a relay
Shorting Rod: harder on the marked

bad_modifiers.why: a rod planted in the ground does not travel; falls back
nothing about a rod is nerves; falls back
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.name: Bell Jar
skills.summary: One enemy within 12 m is sealed under a jar of still air for 6 s: 30 damage and a Live mark. Nothing passes in or out of it: no auras, no death burst, no arcs. Overload it and the whole arc stays inside: +60 for every other marked enemy within 12 m.
skills.verb_fit: Insulate is "block a jump, isolate a target": Wind's Dead Air (a bubble of still air) put over one body.

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: jump out of the jar it seals. The seal is lost
nothing about a jar is nerves; falls back
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.name: Dead Line
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a ring 3 m across hums for 6 s. Enemies inside cannot cast, drum or call for help. Each takes 20, a Live mark and an interrupt once, on entering.
skills.verb_fit: Silence is "dead quiet: casting and calls fail": Wind's Lull (dead air, where shots drop) for sound instead.

good_modifiers.word: Sealed Line: those inside are Insulated too

bad_modifiers.why: a mark every tick, not once: it turns a ring of silence into a mark engine. It should not act
its own opposite: a crack in the silence. It should not act
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.change_note: Entering now also costs 20 (it only marked and interrupted), so power has a number.
